name: Psycolgy
description: Educational psychology with special reference to Children with Special Needs (CWSN) covering human development, learning theories, motivation, socio-cultural influences, and psychological processes.

topics.name: Human Development and Psychosocial Aspects
topics.description: Theoretical approaches to human development across life stages and psychosocial impact of disability on family dynamics.

subtopics.name: Approaches and Stages of Human Development
subtopics.description: Theories and progression through major life stages from early years to adulthood.

concepts.name: Theoretical Approaches to Human Development
concepts.description: Overview of major theoretical perspectives explaining human growth and developmental changes.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand foundational developmental theories and their perspectives on human growth.

concepts.name: The Early Years Stage
concepts.description: Physical, cognitive, and socio-emotional milestones during early childhood.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify key milestones and developmental characteristics of early childhood.

concepts.name: Adolescence Stage
concepts.description: Physical, cognitive, and social changes during adolescent development.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze developmental challenges and characteristics during the adolescent stage.

concepts.name: Transition into Adulthood
concepts.description: Key transitions, adjustments, and developmental goals moving from adolescence into adulthood.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand the challenges and adjustments during the transition to adult life.

subtopics.name: Psychosocial Aspects and Family Issues
subtopics.description: Psychosocial implications of disability and challenges faced by families of CWSN.

concepts.name: Psychosocial Aspects of Disability
concepts.description: Social and psychological impact of living with a disability on self-concept and social interactions.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the psychosocial challenges and emotional dynamics surrounding disability.

concepts.name: Family Issues and Disability Dynamics
concepts.description: Stress, coping strategies, adaptation, and systemic impacts on families raising children with special needs.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify family dynamics, coping mechanisms, and support strategies for families of CWSN.

topics.name: Psychology, Educational Psychology, and Learning Theories
topics.description: Foundations of educational psychology, intelligence, and classical/modern theories of learning.

subtopics.name: Educational Psychology and Intelligence
subtopics.description: Relevance, scope, and fundamental concepts of educational psychology and human intelligence.

concepts.name: Educational Psychology: Relevance and Scope
concepts.description: Definition, significance, and applications of psychology in educational settings.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand the scope and application of educational psychology in teaching-learning environments.

concepts.name: Intelligence and Assessment
concepts.description: Concepts, theories, and measurement of intelligence in diverse learning contexts.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze theories of intelligence and their relevance to individual differences in learning.

subtopics.name: Basic Principles and Theories of Learning
subtopics.description: Core psychological theories explaining how learning occurs in individuals.

concepts.name: Thorndike's Connectionism / Trial and Error Theory
concepts.description: Thorndike's laws of learning including Law of Effect, Exercise, and Readiness.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply Thorndike's laws of learning to classroom situations.

concepts.name: Pavlov's Classical Conditioning
concepts.description: Principles of stimulus-response association, conditioned responses, extinction, and generalization.
concepts.learning_objective: Explain the mechanics and educational applications of classical conditioning.

concepts.name: Skinner's Operant Conditioning
concepts.description: Reinforcement, punishment, shaping, and behavior modification techniques.
concepts.learning_objective: Demonstrate understanding of operant conditioning principles and behavior reinforcement.

concepts.name: Bandura's Social Learning Theory
concepts.description: Observational learning, modeling, vicarious reinforcement, and self-efficacy.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand social cognitive theory and observational learning processes.

concepts.name: Piaget's Theory of Cognitive Development
concepts.description: Stages of cognitive development, schema, assimilation, accommodation, and equilibration.
concepts.learning_objective: Apply Piaget's constructivist principles and cognitive stages to instruction.

concepts.name: Vygotsky's Socio-Cultural Theory
concepts.description: Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD), scaffolding, and the role of social interaction and culture.
concepts.learning_objective: Utilize Vygotsky's socio-cultural concepts like ZPD and scaffolding in special education contexts.

topics.name: Learner Diversity, Motivation, and Socio-Cultural Contexts
topics.description: Individual learning styles, learner types, motivational dynamics, and socio-cultural factors impacting CWSN.

subtopics.name: Learning Styles and Motivation
subtopics.description: Variations in how individuals learn and psychological mechanisms of motivation.

concepts.name: Learning Styles and Types of Learners
concepts.description: Visual, auditory, kinesthetic, and individual learning preferences among diverse students.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify different learning styles and adapt instruction to diverse learner profiles.

concepts.name: Motivation in Learning
concepts.description: Intrinsic and extrinsic motivation, achievement motivation, and methods to motivate learners.
concepts.learning_objective: Evaluate motivational theories and strategies to engage students with diverse learning needs.

subtopics.name: Socio-Cultural Factors and CWSN Implications
subtopics.description: Impact of socio-cultural background on learning and specialized implications for CWSN.

concepts.name: Socio-Cultural Factors Affecting Learning
concepts.description: Role of family environment, socio-economic status, community background, and culture in learning outcomes.
concepts.learning_objective: Analyze how socio-cultural factors influence student engagement and achievement.

concepts.name: Implications for Children with Special Needs (CWSN)
concepts.description: Educational adaptations, inclusive practices, and barrier-free learning environments for CWSN.
concepts.learning_objective: Formulate pedagogical strategies tailored to the socio-cultural and learning needs of CWSN.

topics.name: Psychological Processes in Disability Contexts
topics.description: Cognitive and psychological functions and their pedagogical implications across various types of disabilities.

subtopics.name: Psychological Processes and Disability Impacts
subtopics.description: Attention, perception, memory, thinking, and emotional processes in children with diverse disabilities.

concepts.name: Cognitive and Psychological Processes
concepts.description: Mechanisms of attention, sensory perception, memory processing, problem solving, and language comprehension.
concepts.learning_objective: Understand key cognitive processes involved in learning and knowledge acquisition.

concepts.name: Implications for Sensory and Physical Impairments
concepts.description: How visual, hearing, and physical disabilities alter psychological processing and educational needs.
concepts.learning_objective: Assess psychological and learning implications for children with visual, auditory, or motor impairments.

concepts.name: Implications for Cognitive and Neurological Impairments
concepts.description: Psychological process alterations in intellectual disability, specific learning disabilities, and autism spectrum conditions.
concepts.learning_objective: Identify instructional and psychological support required for children with cognitive and neurodevelopmental conditions.
